verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a first-party Bulk Import in the desktop app: Notion Markdown + CSV exports go through a type-mapping review step, and Markdown files can be imported directly. Evernote is not imported natively; users must convert ENEX batches to Markdown + media themselves before importing, and Roam is not mentioned at all. Missing for 10: native Evernote (ENEX) import, any Roam import path, documented preservation of internal links and attachments, independent or hands-on corroboration of import fidelity.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can import my existing notes from Notion, Evernote, Roam, or plain Markdown with structure, links, and attachments preserved

citations.quote: Export selected content as Markdown + CSV. Review mapping in Bulk Import, then import in the Capacities desktop app.
Export from Evernote (`ENEX` recommended). Convert each batch to Markdown + media.
make sure you have one Markdown file per note, then import in the Capacities desktop app.
